description: Kayla Copilot golden query set. Each entry asserts invariants, not prose. 'require' is a list of alternative groups: every group must have at least one member present in the answer. 'forbid' must be absent. Placeholders resolve from canonical site data at run time so the set cannot drift from projects.ts / products.ts / gems.ts / site.ts. Optional fields added in Phase 6: 'context' (KaylaPageContext, defaults to home) and 'history' (prior turns, defaults to none) exercise page-aware and multi-turn behavior; 'expectActions' / 'expectSources' assert the response carries at least one action / structured source; 'expectRouteMode' asserts the exact routing lane (see KaylaRouteMode) that produced the answer. This harness always runs with the AI provider disabled (see kayla-golden-check.mjs), so 'provider-fallback' entries prove graceful local degradation for a synthesis-shaped question, not live provider execution — that is proven separately by the live production smoke suite.

tiers.1: Critical deterministic facts and scope boundaries. Required: 100%.
tiers.2: Common FDS questions including paraphrases and aliases. Target: >= 95%.
tiers.3: Adversarial and open questions. Measured; must fail honestly rather than fabricate.
